_comment: Curated input for build-index.py. A skill is in the catalogue only if it is listed under 'skills' (key: <source id>/<path of the skill folder in the repo>). 'featured' is a rank, 1 first. 'reserved_names' are never offered. 'excluded' records why groups of upstream skills were left out (documentation only).

excluded.anthropic-work: partner-built/*: third-party plugins tied to one vendor's connector (Apollo, Slack, Zoom, Common Room)
excluded.anthropic-work: small-business/*: every skill reads ../../shared/*.md files that live outside the skill folder
excluded.anthropic-work: engineering, cowork-plug: need a coding agent, a plugin host, specific connectors, a local file workspace or pip-installed toolchains
excluded.anthropic-work: CRM-bound sales skills,: useful only with a connected system of record, or too technical for the audience
excluded.anthropic: docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx: the app creates these files natively; the skills expect LibreOffice and a shell
excluded.anthropic: claude-api, mcp-builder, skil: engineering, shell scripts or pip installs
excluded.anthropic: doc-coauthoring: no licence file or licence field in the skill folder
excluded.anthropic: brand-guidelines, academy-gui: specific to Anthropic's brand or products, or changes how every answer ends
excluded.rezvani: engineering, engineering-team,: engineering, coding-agent slash commands, or regulatory specialisms
excluded.rezvani: routers (*-skills, chief-of-sta: only route to or coordinate other skills, or keep state in a project folder
excluded.rezvani: aeo, page-cro, site-architectur: bundled scripts open network connections or start processes
excluded.rezvani: dossier, grants, patent, syllab: need Node.js, a shell, browser automation, pip installs or specific connectors
excluded.rezvani: sales-engineer: matched an automatic safety pattern (a checklist line about sharing demo credentials; benign, left out anyway)
excluded.rezvani: content-humanizer, andreessen,: framed around hiding AI authorship, imitates a real person, targets video tools the app lacks, or deprecated
excluded.rezvani: team-communications, internal-c: same name as, derived from, or overlapping an included skill
